integrity: The closed forms are derived analytically from exact indicator moments and checked computationally in small instances; computational tests alone are not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform random graphs only. Independent-edge covariance zero does not establish independence. Novelty compared to inspected research, not exhaustively certified historical priority. Independent audit not performed.
title: Universal fixed-edge anticorrelation and a binomial sign transition for triangle–open-wedge counts
